hypotheses.claim: Rich positive perpetual-futures basis at or above the trailing 95th percentile predicts higher 14-day underlying-asset crash incidence and worse downside tail severity.
Extremely cheap negative basis predicts elevated forward downside tail risk; keep it distinct from rich-positive basis.
Extreme absolute basis magnitude predicts elevated forward downside tail risk regardless of sign; do not merge this with directional tests.

rules: Never overwrite a prior hypothesis or result.
Every new hypothesis requires a unique ID and preregistration before outcomes.
Holdout outcomes cannot select replacement parameters.
